title: Align & name player archetypes across seasons
author: andrew
rationale: Re-fit fine archetypes on all >=900-min players and align them across seasons into stable named labels for downstream use.
question: Can per-season fine clusters be aligned into stable, named archetypes covering all >=900-min players?
method_summary: Cluster all >=900-min players per season (UMAP10D->HDBSCAN leaf); meta-cluster the 32 per-season centroids into 9 canonical archetypes; name by role+tier. Reads all_players_season_panel.csv.
key_findings: 9 canonical named archetypes; 7 present in all 3 seasons; 999 player-seasons labeled (65 noise).
Fine archetypes encode role AND quality tier (elite vs premium attacker; attacking vs defensive defender).
Meta-clustering per-season cluster centroids gives stable cross-season labels.
Assignments are football-sensible without using position as a feature (Salah/Haaland=Elite goalscorer, Pickford=Goalkeeper).
